'''Vesperia''', officially the '''Republic of Vesperia''', is a sovereign state on the western coast of [[Arcadia]]. Its capital and largest city is [[Vilena]].

== History ==
=== Founding ===
The republic was proclaimed in [[1812]] after the [[War of the Two Crowns|Two Crowns War]].

=== Modern era ===
{{Main|History of Vesperia}}
Since 1950 the country has been a member of the [[League of Nations]].

== Geography ==
Vesperia covers {{convert|420000|km2|sqmi}} and borders [[Ostrava]] to the north.
